summary: Re-test pass for iteration 8 defensive fixes. Backend pytest suite: 148/148 PASS (full run had 4 transient failures due to zombie parallel pytest processes from prior runs mutating shared admin/user fixtures; on isolated rerun all 4 PASSED, confirming flake not regression). Frontend Composer media data-testids all present; PostItem media-block renders on /feed; EssayDetail cover image renders correctly (extra-media MediaBlock only renders when an essay has >1 media item, which is expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Defensive .get('text','') fix on the 3 legacy test files is correct and unblocks the suite without reverting the essay-feed payload optimization.

EssayDetail renders cover image directly as (lines 177-181); only extra media (beyond cover) uses MediaBlock. This is intentional and avoids double-rendering the cover but means [data-testid='media-block'] will not appear on essays that only have a cover image. Consider wrapping the cover in MediaBlock for a uniform testid surface if QA wants single-selector media verification on EssayDetail.

context_for_next_testing_agent: When running the full pytest suite, ENSURE no other pytest processes are alive on the box first (pkill -f 'pytest /app'). Several tests in test_phase3_moderation_follows and test_phase4_picks_analytics_payments depend on a seeded admin/test user; concurrent pytest runs from a previously interrupted/spawned session will racily delete or rebuild that user, causing transient 401 'User missing' and KeyError 'items'. In iteration 9 I observed 4 such failures in the full run; rerunning just those 4 in isolation after pkill produced 4/4 PASS. So treat suite-wide flakes that mention 'User missing' / 'items' as environment, not regression — but always confirm by isolated rerun.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new issues. Iteration 8's 7 regressions are fully resolved by the .get('text','') defensive fix in 3 legacy test files. Full suite is now 148/148 PASS.
